description.narrative: IFCs long-term financing is expected to support access to finance for SME agribusinesses and women-owned SME agribusinesses in focused countries in the Latin America region. In particular, the project will target climate smart agriculture and other green assets that promote sustainable agricultural practices. Beyond the project-level impact, IFC anticipates that the investment will further promote greater sustainability in the targeted markets by addressing gender equality in the agricultural financing sector, encouraging replication by other financial institutions.

The proposed project consists of a senior financing package of up to US$160 million to Latin American Agribusiness Development Corp., (LAAD or the Company) an existing IFC client, to support its expansion to finance green and women-owned SME agribusinesses in Latin America. The financing is composed of an up to US$70 million A loan and an up to US$90 million B/Parallel loan mobilization.
